questions.q: What did the stepmother demand of her husband?
o: To send the children to school
To take the children away from the house
questions.e: “I can't stand these three children — take them out of the house.”

questions.q: How did the children find their way home the first time?
o: By the ashes they scattered along the way
questions.e: They scattered ashes along the path.

questions.q: Why couldn't they return the second time?
o: Animals ate the bran they scattered
They got lost in the fog

questions.q: How did the girl save her brother from the strangers?
o: She led him away at night
She had the old woman sit on the shovel, and the woman was baked in the oven
questions.e: The old woman sat on the shovel and was baked in the oven.

questions.q: Whom did the children meet at the spring?
o: A woman who blessed the girl
questions.e: At the spring the woman blessed the girl.

questions.q: What gift did the woman give the kind girl?
o: Pearls from her eyes when she wept, golden roses from her mouth when she spoke
questions.e: Pearls instead of tears, golden roses instead of words.

questions.q: What happened to the stepmother's daughter after meeting the woman?
o: Bloody tears flowed from her eyes and spit sprayed from her mouth
questions.e: Bloody tears and spitting instead of pearls and roses.
